fields.fam: family: the material a block is cut, shaped, dyed, waxed or weathered from (a family name)
fields.col: dye colour, one of the 16 (absent: none)
fields.t: tier: uncommon, rare, precious (absent: common); the highest tier among the raw items of its cheapest recipe
fields.sv: survival class: craft, drop, silk, loot, cost, none (craft: a recipe makes it; drop: mining drops it; silk: only with silk touch; loot: chests, mobs or trades; cost: placed with another item; none: creative only)
fields.ft: fitting (1): functional, not material (doors, glass, lights that are not cubes, beds, signs, plants, redstone parts...)

compact.note: families: members of every family with more than one (any other block is a family of its own, named by its id); tiers: whole families, else blocks (the rest is common); dyed: the families whose members are dyed (a member's colour is its id's dye prefix); survival: the blocks not simply crafted or mined (silk: silk touch only; loot: chests, mobs, trades; cost: placed with another item; none: creative only)
